F001.acceptance: the Architecture page renders a coverage banner showing the confidence ceiling, each extractor's status, and any missing-extractor kinds from the view-state coverage block; a low or medium ceiling is rendered as an explicit incompleteness statement, never hidden; the banner is driven only by real coverage data (no hard-coded high).

F002.acceptance: the page renders intent claims distinctly labelled as declared/intended (not as-built fact), shows each diff entry's taxonomy as a drift badge (aligned / documented_unimplemented / stale_adr), and renders an honest empty state when there are no claims; nothing presents intent as observed evidence.

F003.acceptance: a journey test boots the real shell (createJarvis init) on a producer-generated architecture view-state and asserts the rendered Architecture surface shows the coverage banner, at least one declared intent claim, and the diff, with no raw JSON leaked and no over-confident/fake-fresh rendering.
